headlines.title: Heat To Host 2028 All-Star Weekend
headlines.wce_line: The last time Miami hosted All-Star festivities was in 1990, making this upcoming event a significant milestone for the city.

headlines.title: Scotty Pippen Jr, Isaiah Stewart To Miss Time For Grizzlies

headlines.title: The historic (and absurd) longevity of Steph Curry and Kevin Durant
headlines.wce_line: Steph Curry is averaging more 3-pointers and a higher 3P% this season (4.7, 45%) than in his MVP year, defying age with elite shooting.

headlines.title: Jaylen Brown is rewriting an old narrative﻿ with a new chapter in Philadelphia
headlines.wce_line: Brown's new role with the Sixers sees him operating at an 84th percentile points per 75 pace, aiming for a title despite his past frustrations.

headlines.title: ‘Let's check the ball up': Jaylen Brown ready for first game against Celtics
headlines.wce_line: Jaylen Brown's box plus/minus ranks at the 69th percentile, showing his significant impact on the court despite the end of his decade with the Celtics.

headlines.title: JJ Redick Says Luka Doncic Was 'Orchestrating' Following Win Over Hawks

headlines.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo 'Speechless' Over Doc Rivers' Podcast Comments

headlines.title: Luka Doncic ruthlessly trolls Hawks fans over franchise’s biggest mistake: ‘You could have had me’
headlines.wce_line: Dončić's performance, with 32 points, 10 assists, and five steals, cemented his status as the league's top scorer this season.

headlines.title: Warriors backcourt depth takes hit losing Brandon Williams, Will Richard
headlines.wce_line: Williams' left hamstring injury and Richard's indefinite absence due to a thumb UCL tear further diminish the Warriors' backcourt depth.

headlines.wce_line: Wembanyama's 40-point, 11-rebound, 8-block performance pushed his season True Shooting percentage to the 86th percentile.

headlines.title: Cooper Flagg joins elite company with 40-point game in Mavs win over Pacers
headlines.wce_line: Cooper Flagg's back-to-back dunks in the first quarter contributed to his 43-point performance, joining Kevin Durant as one of only two teenagers to achieve such a feat.

headlines.title: Brandon Williams leaves Warriors game with hamstring injury
headlines.wce_line: Brandon Williams' departure affects the Warriors, as he ranks in the 88th percentile for Usage %.

headlines.title: Luka Dončić made sure to get the basketball after Cameron Carr’s first basket

headlines.wce_line: Wembanyama's performance included the fewest minutes (25) any player has ever scored at least 40 points, 10 rebounds, and 8 blocks in a game since 1980-81.

headlines.title: Lakers star makes bold Luka Doncic declaration after he surpasses Magic Johnson, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
headlines.wce_line: Doncic's play this season has put him in the 99th percentile for points, true shooting, and assists, cementing Kessler's declaration.

headlines.title: Luka Dončić makes sure Lakers rookie gets a moment to remember after major milestone
headlines.wce_line: Dončić's final assist of the night went to retrieving a game ball for rookie Cameron Carr, marking Carr's first NBA points.

headlines.title: Luka Doncic nearly notches triple-double as he continues to dominate NBA
headlines.wce_line: Dončić's return contributed to the Lakers' victory, showcasing his dominance with near-triple-double stats and high-savant percentiles in points and three-point shooting.

headlines.title: Stephen Curry tries on former teammate Jordan Poole's sunglasses
headlines.wce_line: Stephen Curry showcased his signature three-point shooting while wearing Jordan Poole's sunglasses during pregame warmups.

headlines.title: Luka Dončić breaks out dance moves during dominant win over Hawks
headlines.wce_line: Dončić continues his dominant season, breaking out dance moves and leading the Lakers to a 9-2 record with performances in the 99th percentile for points and true shooting.

headlines.title: No Austin Reaves, no problem. First-place Lakers beat Hawks for sixth consecutive win
headlines.wce_line: Doncic's 32 points and 10 assists helped the Lakers secure their sixth consecutive win despite missing key players Austin Reaves and Quentin Grimes.

headlines.wce_line: Both Luka Doncic and Jalen Brunson led their teams to undefeated weeks, with Doncic scoring at least 40 points in each game and averaging a career-high 40.1 PPG this season.
